title: A learner who has had each move confirmed by a teacher experiences terror when they must act on judgment no one will confirm
body:
- A learner at the mastery threshold holds theoretical knowledge of the principles but has not yet built the confidence that comes from applying them without external confirmation.
- The terror arises from the gap between understanding what to do and accepting full responsibility for doing it, with no teacher left to consult.
- Crossing the threshold requires abandoning the safety of having a teacher confirm each move and trusting one's own judgment instead.
conversion: The external confirmation that made learning feel safe becomes unavailable at the threshold of mastery, and what the learner meets without it is terror.
